title: Store scorecard capstone
objective: Combine SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, XLOOKUP, ROUND and IF into a one-row-per-store scorecard.
instructions: A1:C13 is a weekly sales log in K, E1:F4 is a table of store targets and I7:I10 holds the rules. For each store in H2:H4 fill the scorecard: I total sales (SUMIFS on the log), J good weeks (COUNTIFS of the store's weeks with sales at or above the good-week level in I7), K target (XLOOKUP in the target table), L achievement % (total divided by target, times 100, rounded to 1 decimal place) and M rating. Rating is "Star" when achievement is at or above I9 and good weeks are at least I8; otherwise "Watch" when achievement is at or above I10; otherwise "Action".
hints: Total: =SUMIFS($C$2:$C$13,$A$2:$A$13,H2). Good weeks: COUNTIFS with the store test and the condition ">="&$I$7.
Rating: an IF containing AND(L2>=$I$9,J2>=$I$8) for Star, then a second IF for Watch against $I$10, with Action as the last value.
